The '''Ermi''' were a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. According to the play [[Evocar (play)|''Evocar'']], written by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Author/Legends|playwright]] [[Direus'pei]] around [[671 BBY]], the Ermi were driven to extinction by the [[Tionese (group)/Legends|Tionese]] [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Xim/Legends|Xim]]. When Xim was captured and placed on trial by the Hutts, he justified the extinction of the Ermi on the basis that they were [[Slavery/Legends|slavers]].<ref name="Xim" /> Xim's conquests occurred approximately between [[25,130 BBY|25,130]] and [[25,100 BBY]].<ref name="Xim Week: The History of Xim and the Tion Cluster">{{SW|url=news/essential-atlas-extra-the-history-of-xim-and-the-tion-cluster|text=Essential Atlas Extra: The History of Xim and the Tion Cluster|int=Xim Week: The History of Xim and the Tion Cluster}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Ermi were created by [[Michael Kogge]] for his article ''[[Xim Week: The Despotica]]'', published on [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|''Hyperspace'']] in [[2009]]. In [[2010]], the video game [[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)|''Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures'']] created several items with the blurb "The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] of the planet Ermi often made their lightsabers with multifaceted gems&hellip;." but did not make an explicit connection to the Ermi species.
